scope: Adult Study v1 specification: how original content is authored and validated. It contains no lessons and no vocabulary; it is the contract content must satisfy.

dimensionNotes.practicalInformation: practical information use: reading, filling in and acting on real-life information (forms, notices, schedules, prices, directions, messages)

frameworkMapping: metadata only; no level claims to be an official CEFR, TOPIK, JLPT, HSK or similar result

forbidden: importing, copying, translating, summarizing or paraphrasing any legacy viet.mobile corpus text while its rights are UNCLEARED
scraping, repackaging or re-expressing jw.org or any other third-party publication text
reusing a sentence, dialogue, passage, lesson order or exercise from a third-party course
text produced by a model from a third-party source passage
originalityRules: every dialogue, passage and example sentence is written for LIFE.HELP from a situation description and a target vocabulary/grammar list, not from a source text
every content record names its author or generator and the authoring record that justifies ORIGINAL (provenance.rights.evidence)
open-licensed or public-domain material is allowed only with the licence id and attribution duties recorded; it is never mixed into an ORIGINAL pack without its own record
a native-speaker review is recorded per pack before it is published; unreviewed packs stay in draft
authoring.packGate: validateContentPack plus publishProblems (lib/learn/products/rights.ts): no pack with UNCLEARED or REJECTED rights is publishable

shared: lesson and exercise types (multiple_choice, fill_blank, match, translation, word_order)
per-dimension proficiency model and level placement

needs: romanization as a learner aid only
honorific / politeness level tag on every example
kanji only from the level's kanji list
root and affixes where affixation is taught
full diacritics (the tone is part of the word)

engine.uiLocales: instruction language is the learner's UI locale; target text never carries instruction-language text and vice versa (the two-layer rule of the question bank)

contentTargetsV1: per target and level: a pilot pack sized by the review capacity, not by a corpus total; no target counts of lessons or words are promised here
provisional: level bands are authoring guidance on the shared ten-step scale; they are not calibrated against learner data and make no external-framework claim
